risk: Export contains no Git histories or branches
mitigation: Use accepted suite monorepo and preserve baseline hashes

risk: Virtual environments and transitive dependency locks are excluded
mitigation: Build pinned clean environments and CI from reviewed locks

risk: Complete raw dictionary sources are external and machine-local
mitigation: Provision licensed sources by recorded identity and verify deterministic rebuilds

risk: Catalog handoff is advisory and has no receiving-system acceptance receipt
mitigation: Keep v0.1 advisory and require a supplied versioned registry plus separate acceptance before integration

risk: Sister parse-tree logic transition and authority schemas are absent
mitigation: Exclude unavailable schemas and require separate inventory migration validation and acceptance if later supplied

risk: Snapshot checks do not establish security performance or production behavior
mitigation: Retain bounded P07 testbed evidence and require new external or production criteria if scope expands

risk: Large generated browser data can obscure source and build drift
mitigation: Separate source generated and release manifests and compare deterministic outputs

risk: Hosted authentication authorization and secrets model is unspecified
mitigation: Keep release local offline single-user with no service credentials and require new authorization for hosted operation

risk: Exact-candidate data license and attribution compliance is not yet verified
mitigation: Apply accepted no-telemetry no-retention policy and verify OEWN license and attribution in the candidate

risk: Service availability scaling and multi-user targets are unspecified
mitigation: Make no service claim and require new authorization before service work

risk: Planning artifacts could be mistaken for accepted canon
mitigation: Keep explicit truth states and require acceptance entries before implementation

risk: Historical manifest cannot describe new development state
mitigation: Keep it immutable and create versioned release manifests later

risk: Rollback has not been rehearsed against a deployed candidate
mitigation: Stateless artifact restore is rehearsed; require deployed-state rehearsal if deployment is later authorized

risk: Unbounded provider output or nested metadata could exhaust local resources
mitigation: Enforce cardinality depth item string and diagnostic bounds plus torture regression tests

risk: The test runner could use an incomplete interpreter write reports outside its evidence directory or hide excessive output
mitigation: Run pinned dependency preflight confine append-only JSON receipts bound output and test timeouts

risk: In-process third-party layers cannot be forcibly timed out or memory-isolated
mitigation: Use trusted bounded layers now and design process isolation before accepting external providers

risk: Pure-Python wheel bytes differ between Python 3.14 and Python 3.11 through 3.13
mitigation: Canonical Python 3.11 wheel is packaged and the outer candidate archive reproduced byte-identically

risk: Newly authored package has no selected license or distribution terms
mitigation: Keep artifacts internal and obtain the user's terms decision before any publication then add metadata notices and rebuild

risk: The packaged Wiktionary manifest records CC BY-SA 3.0 plus GFDL while the current upstream copyright page records CC BY-SA 4.0 plus GFDL
mitigation: Do not redistribute the extracted data until the exact 2026-09-02 dump terms and attribution chain are verified or remove the material
